# ref 0.2.1

A follow-up release focused on native Wayland packaging for the Linux GUI, an encrypted and TLS-ready `ref-web`, cross-interface workflow refinements, infinite retries across transient and provider errors, and comprehensive error reporting.

## Before you update

- **Protocol version 4.** `ref-server` now checks client protocol versions on handshake and refuses mismatched connections (`protocol_mismatch`) with instructions on whether to update the client or run `ref-server --stop` and restart it. Update `ref`, `ref-gui`, `ref-web`, and `ref-server` together, and restart any `ref-server` you started yourself. (`ref-server --stop` and `--status` still work across protocol versions.)
- **`ref-web` sign-in changed.** Cookies, `/login`, and `/api/info` are gone. `ref-web` now authenticates over an end-to-end encrypted WebSocket channel with a key (`--key`, `REF_WEB_KEY`, or `<state dir>/web/login-token`) passed in the URL `#key=` fragment and stored stretched with scrypt in the browser's `localStorage`. Existing `/login?token=…` bookmarks still load the page and read `?token=`.
- **Linux GUI system libraries.** Native Wayland support adds `libwayland-client0`, `libwayland-cursor0`, and `libwayland-egl1` to the Debian/Ubuntu package list in the README.

## Desktop GUI

- **Native Wayland on Linux.** The packaged Linux GUI now bundles Qt's `qwayland` platform plugin and Wayland helpers, running natively on Wayland when `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` is set and falling back to X11/XWayland. Input methods (fcitx5, IBus) work over `zwp_text_input_v3` on native Wayland; installing `ref-gui.desktop` and `ref.svg` enables the window icon on Wayland compositors.
- **UI & stability fixes.** Single-session panes stay borderless and cross-fade cleanly with split view; fixed split-tile height, composer height, and `ChatView` scroll-hold edge cases; fixed teardown `TypeError`s when split tiles leave; fixed Markdown link colours (`LinkColorizer`), variant label spacing, context-meter tooltip delay, and light-theme `*-text` contrast and focus rings.

## Web UI

- **Port memory and instance lookup.** Without `--port`, `ref-web` picks a random free port (`10000–65535`), remembers it in `<state dir>/web/port`, and reuses it while free. Running `ref-web` again probes running instances (`<state dir>/web/instances/<pid>.json` + authenticated `/api/ping`) and opens the matching instance in the browser.
- **Key and encrypted WebSocket channel.** Browser messages are encrypted and authenticated with XChaCha20-Poly1305 using keys derived from the login key (`scrypt` + `HKDF`) and per-connection nonces. Missing, rotated, or salt-mismatched keys show a dedicated *Enter the key* page without retrying in the background.
- **Self-signed TLS.** Binding to a non-loopback `--host` enables HTTPS by default with a self-signed certificate in `<state dir>/web/tls/`, SHA-256 fingerprint output, HTTP → HTTPS `308` redirects, and `Host`-header DNS-rebinding checks. Pass `--no-tls` when running behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy.
- **Path dialog and light theme.** Missing directories (`dir_not_found`) are treated silently as an empty list while real I/O errors are surfaced; light-theme text tones and focus rings match the GUI.

## All interfaces (TUI, GUI, Web)

- **Split view focus & foreground hiding.** Entering split view hides the current foreground session (returning it when you leave) and starts with no tile focused so `Esc` does not conflict. Click a focused tile (its header in the GUI) or empty background to deselect.
- **Root-task markers.** Spawned sub-sessions show a `⟲ <root>` chip in split view and tint unfocused borders and status dots by their root task; user-created tiles remain unmarked.
- **Tool cards and permission previews.**
  - `edit` and `write` permission requests show a server-computed diff preview before you approve or deny.
  - Collapsed `edit` and `write` cards show the file path, `+`/`-` counts, the first 8 diff lines (`+N more`), and structured edit remap warnings (`meta.warnings`), expanding to full details.
  - Finished `question` cards show a compact summary of the chosen answers when collapsed.
  - TUI releases chat hold space when tool cards collapse or toggle.
- **`/sessions` creator filter.** Filter sessions between *All*, *User-created*, and *By creator*, see creator badges (`⟲ <creator>`) on spawned rows, and search by creator name or id.
- **File drop & paste (GUI & Web).** Dropping any file or pasting `file://` URLs/paths attaches supported images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP up to 20 MiB) as `[Image N]` thumbnails and inserts local file paths at the cursor for non-image files.

## Backend (`ref-server`), tools, and configuration

- **Retry all request, stream, and network errors indefinitely.** All HTTP failures (including 400, 401, 402, 403, 404, 429 including `insufficient_quota`/billing, 5xx, and responses with `x-should-retry: false`), malformed or dropped SSE streams, and timeouts now retry indefinitely with exponential backoff up to `retry.max_delay` (default 600 s) until aborted (`Esc Esc`). Only local request-preparation/encoding failures or context overflows that remain too large after compaction stop immediately.
- **Cross-session history & `resume_session`.** `list_sessions` accepts `history: true` (newest 200 closed sessions) and `creator` (`"user"` or creator name/id); `read_session` reads closed history sessions; new `resume_session(session, prompt?)` tool (gated by `can_spawn`, enabled on `build` by default) reloads a closed session into the background.
- **Configuration, LLM, and tooling fixes.**
  - Expand `~` in string-form `instructions`.
  - Turn off per-agent `question` defaults whenever any global `question` permission rule is present.
  - Preserve raw tool-call JSON arguments on OpenAI Chat and Responses replay.
  - Saturate huge `retry-after` headers instead of panicking.
  - Lock `ref-server --mock` temporary directories and clean up stale leftovers on start (`--mock` `fail` script now returns HTTP 413 context overflow).
  - Propagated previously swallowed errors and completed a coding-standard pass across Rust crates, TUI, GUI C++/QML, and Web.

---

# ref 0.2.1（简体中文）

0.2.1 是一个完善与加固版本，重点带来 Linux GUI 的原生 Wayland 打包支持、`ref-web` 密钥与端到端加密通道和自签名 TLS、跨端交互一致性改进、全错误无限重试以及全仓库错误处理完善。

## 更新前请注意

- **协议升至第 4 版。** `ref-server` 会在握手时校验客户端协议版本，版本不匹配时拒绝连接（`protocol_mismatch`）并提示升级客户端或执行 `ref-server --stop` 重启后端。请一并更新 `ref`、`ref-gui`、`ref-web` 和 `ref-server`，并重启手动启动的 `ref-server`。（`ref-server --stop` 和 `--status` 可跨协议版本使用。）
- **`ref-web` 登录方式变更。** 移除了 cookie、`/login` 与 `/api/info`。`ref-web` 现在通过端到端加密的 WebSocket 通道校验密钥（`--key`、`REF_WEB_KEY` 或 `<state dir>/web/login-token`），通过 URL `#key=` 片段传入并在浏览器 `localStorage` 中保存经 scrypt 拉伸后的派生物。旧的 `/login?token=…` 书签仍可打开页面并读取 `?token=`。
- **Linux GUI 系统依赖。** 原生 Wayland 支持在 README 的 Debian/Ubuntu 依赖列表中新增了 `libwayland-client0`、`libwayland-cursor0` 与 `libwayland-egl1`。

## 桌面 GUI

- **Linux 原生 Wayland 支持。** 打包后的 Linux GUI 现已附带 Qt 的 `qwayland` 平台插件及 Wayland 辅助插件，设置 `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` 时原生运行于 Wayland，否则回退到 X11/XWayland。原生 Wayland 下输入法（fcitx5、IBus）通过 `zwp_text_input_v3` 工作；按 README 安装 `ref-gui.desktop` 与 `ref.svg` 后即可在 Wayland 合成器下显示窗口图标。
- **界面与稳定性修复。** 单会话视图保持无边框并与分屏视图交叉淡入淡出；修复分屏分块高度、输入框高度与 `ChatView` 滚动锚定边界问题；修复分块退出时的 `TypeError`；修复 Markdown 链接颜色（`LinkColorizer`）、变体标签间距、上下文指示条悬停提示延迟与浅色主题 `*-text` 对比度及焦点环。

## Web 界面

- **端口记忆与实例发现。** 未指定 `--port` 时，`ref-web` 随机选择空闲端口（`10000–65535`）并记忆到 `<state dir>/web/port`，下次优先复用。再次运行 `ref-web` 会通过实例记录（`<state dir>/web/instances/<pid>.json`）与带签名的 `/api/ping` 探测已有实例并直接在浏览器打开。
- **密钥与加密通道。** 浏览器与 `ref-web` 间的所有 WebSocket 消息均使用基于登录密钥（`scrypt` + `HKDF`）与每次连接随机数派生的密钥进行 XChaCha20-Poly1305 加密认证。缺少密钥、密钥变更或盐值变化时展示专门的*输入密钥*页面且不再后台盲目重连。
- **自签名 TLS。** 绑定非回环 `--host` 时默认启用 HTTPS，在 `<state dir>/web/tls/` 生成自签名证书、打印 SHA-256 指纹、支持 HTTP → HTTPS `308` 重定向与 `Host` 头防 DNS 重绑定校验。位于反向代理后时可传 `--no-tls`。
- **目录选择与浅色主题。** 不存在的目录（`dir_not_found`）静默视为空列表，其他真实 I/O 错误正常提示；浅色主题文字色调与焦点环对齐 GUI。

## 全部界面（TUI、GUI、Web）

- **分屏视图焦点与隐藏当前前台会话。** 进入分屏视图时隐藏当前前台会话（退出分屏时恢复），并默认不聚焦任何分块以避免 `Esc` 冲突；再次点击已聚焦分块（GUI 为标题栏）或空白背景可取消选中。
- **根任务标识。** 由其他会话创建的子会话分块在分屏中显示 `⟲ <根会话>` 标记，并在未聚焦时按根任务色调着色边框与状态点；用户创建的分块保持无标记。
- **工具卡片与授权预览。**
  - `edit` 与 `write` 授权请求在批准或拒绝前展示服务端计算的 diff 预览。
  - 折叠的 `edit` 与 `write` 卡片显示路径、`+`/`-` 行数、前 8 行 diff（及 `+N more`）与结构化编辑重映射警告（`meta.warnings`），展开后查看完整输入、diff 与输出。
  - 已完成的 `question` 卡片折叠时显示已选回答的紧凑摘要。
  - TUI 在折叠或切换工具卡片时释放对话底部保留空间。
- **`/sessions` 创建者筛选。** 支持在*全部*、*用户创建*与*同一创建者*间筛选，子会话显示创建者标记（`⟲ <创建者>`），并支持按创建者名称与 id 搜索。
- **文件拖放与粘贴（GUI 与 Web）。** 拖放任意文件或粘贴 `file://` 地址/路径时，支持的图片（PNG、JPEG、GIF、WebP，≤ 20 MiB）附加为 `[Image N]` 缩略图，其他本地文件在光标处插入路径。

## 后端（`ref-server`）、工具与配置

- **全错误无限重试。** 所有 HTTP 请求错误（含 400、401、402、403、404、含 `insufficient_quota`/账单错误的 429、5xx，即使返回 `x-should-retry: false`）、畸形或中断的 SSE 流及超时均会按指数退避（上限 `retry.max_delay`，默认 600 秒）无限重试，直到用户按 `Esc Esc` 中断；仅本地请求构造/编码失败，或压缩后上下文仍超限时立即报错。
- **跨会话历史与 `resume_session`。** `list_sessions` 新增 `history: true`（最近 200 条已关闭会话）与 `creator` 筛选（`"user"` 或创建者名称/id）；`read_session` 支持读取已关闭的历史会话；新增 `resume_session(session, prompt?)` 工具（受 `can_spawn` 控制，默认对 `build` 开启）将历史会话恢复到后台继续运行。
- **配置、LLM 与工具修复。**
  - 支持在字符串形式的 `instructions` 中展开 `~`。
  - 修复全局 `question` 权限规则存在时关闭默认 `question` 按智能体规则的判定。
  - 在 OpenAI Chat 与 Responses 消息回放中保留原始工具调用 JSON 参数。
  - 超大 `retry-after` 头饱和处理，避免整数溢出 panic。
  - `ref-server --mock` 为临时目录加 `.lock` 锁并在启动时清理无主残留目录（`--mock` `fail` 脚本改为返回 413 上下文溢出错误）。
  - 完成全仓库错误传播补全与代码规范审查重构（Rust、TUI、GUI C++/QML、Web）。
